title: SwarmEvolve Track Manifest (M19)
description: Top-level summary emitted at `<track-root>/track_<lowercase>_manifest.json` by scripts/tracks/track_{a,b,c}.py. One manifest per track root, one lineage row per (seed[, lineage]). Unknown top-level keys are tolerated (future extra telemetry).

schema_version.description: Track-manifest schema version. M19 initial release is 1.

model.description: Model id (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7'). Empty string when the run used --client=mock and no model was specified.

run_dir.description: Absolute path of the lineage (track-A: seed<N>/; track-B: seed<N>/gen<LAST>/; track-C: seed<N>/<LINEAGE>/).

generations_run.description: Number of generation attempts in the lineage's history (any status).

generations_accepted.description: Number of generations whose candidate beat the current champion.

champion_generation.description: Generation index of the current champion; -1 when the seed AI is still champion.

champion_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the champion's .cpp source; null when no champion file is present yet.

champion_fitness_mean.description: Champion's measured mean fitness from the last evaluation; null when not yet measured.

tokens_input.description: Cumulative LLM input tokens across the lineage's generations.

tokens_output.description: Cumulative LLM output tokens across the lineage's generations.
